system.description:
Range 30ft. A sword of force appears and attacks one creature you choose each round, hitting automatically (no roll) for 5d4 force damage. It moves 30ft per round and lasts 1 round per level. Immune to damage; dispelled by Disintegrate or Dispel Magic. Material: a miniature platinum sword worth 250 gp (not consumed).

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Sorcerer
